text:
Lena: Idea: telemetry-driven pin retention policy. Instead of fixed grace windows only, keep pins live or auto-extend based on signal quality. Want quick feedback if this is feasible for cohort-B onboarding.

Raj: Runtime perspective: we can evaluate per-tenant signals (regen-rate, quality-delta, cache-hit-rate). Need to define precise thresholds and a cheap daily job. Avoid thrashing.

Chris: Ops concerns: auto-extensions must be auditable and reversible. We need an append-only retention ledger per tenant and a UI showing why a pin was extended. Also require a human-review queue for enterprise exceptions.

Mira: Product angle: this reduces unnecessary pins but preserves customer experience. Proposed rule: baseline is 60d default. If during last 7 days quality delta > 1.5% for top slices after decay, auto-extend by 30d. Max auto-extends = 3. Customers still get opt-out.

Eva: Legal: any automatic changes touching paid/reserved customers require a signed exception OR explicit contract clause. SMBs can be auto-managed with notice. We'll prepare language.

Raj: Proposed signal set (cheap):
- regen_rate (tokens/sec per tenant)
- prompt_quality_delta (offline eval suite)
- kv_cache_reuse_pct
- customer_error_rate
We'll compute a daily score and compare to thresholds.

Sample pseudo-config we sketched:
```json
{
  "pin_retention": {
    "base_grace_days": 60,
    "auto_extend_days": 30,
    "max_auto_extends": 3,
    "eval_window_days": 7,
    "quality_delta_threshold_pct": 1.5,
    "signals": ["regen_rate","quality_delta","kv_cache_reuse","error_rate"],
    "audit_ledger": true,
    "enterprise_review": true
  }
}
```

Chris: Monitoring requirements: record pre/post diffs for a 200-sample corpus, alert if >2% of samples have unacceptable regressions, and surface audit entries in ops console. Also add a manual override API.

Mira: Acceptance gates: (1) canary to 4 internal tenants + 3 low-touch customers; (2) run 14d shadow + 7d live canary; (3) bench delta <=2% for top-10 slices; (4) audit UI + opt-out live. I'll own benchmark report and product sign-off.

Lena: Rollout sketch: feature-flagged pin_retention controller -> shadow mode -> live canary -> staged global. Action items: Raj build score job & feature-flag (owner Raj, due Thu EOD), Chris add alerts + override API + ledger storage (owner Chris, due Fri), Mira draft acceptance + comms (owner Mira, due Mon), Eva compile contract exceptions list (owner Eva, due Mon). I'll book a 30m follow-up the Tue after the live canary starts.

ops-bot: CI: feature/pin-retention -> staging (dry-run) scheduled 2026-04-12T02:00Z.

Lena: Thanks all. Ping me if you see a blocker. :thumbsup:
